claims.action: Identify distributors and the circular's subject

evidence.quote: Intermediaries who distribute these funds (distributors)
This circular summarises the Securities and Futures Commission’s (SFC) recent observations of licensed corporations’ practices in offering and promoting SFC-authorised funds.

claims.statement: The circular concerns offering and promoting SFC-authorised funds and calls intermediaries distributing these funds 'distributors'.
uncertainty: This contextual scope does not establish the full scope of the incorporated Code provision.

claims.action: Distinguish fund return from distributor top-up return

evidence.quote: Typically, the “guaranteed returns” in such cases comprise: (i) the actual return of the relevant fund(s) invested by the investor (ie, fund return); and (ii) a top-up return to make up the difference between the fund return and the guaranteed rate of return offered by the distributor.

claims.statement: The described guaranteed return typically combines the actual fund return with a distributor top-up covering the difference from the distributor's guaranteed rate; these are distinct components.
uncertainty: The description is typical, not an exhaustive definition or a determination that each component is a gift.

conditions: Return to investors is determined by reference to changes in value of securities, including funds

evidence.quote: these guaranteed return arrangements may constitute a "structured product" under the SFO if the return to investors is determined by reference to the change in value of any securities (including funds).

claims.statement: Guaranteed-return arrangements may constitute a structured product under the SFO when investor returns reference changes in securities values, including fund values.
uncertainty: The source states a possible classification, not an automatic finding; the statutory definition is not supplied.

claims.action: Issue promotional material inviting the Hong Kong public to enter structured products
conditions: An advertisement, invitation or document is or contains an invitation to the Hong Kong public to enter into or offer to enter into structured products

evidence.quote: It is an offence under section 103 of the SFO for a person to issue an advertisement, invitation or document which is or contains an invitation to the Hong Kong public to enter into or offer to enter into any structured products, unless the SFC has authorised the issue or an exemption applies.

claims.statement: Issuing the described public invitation concerning structured products is an offence under section 103 unless the issue is SFC-authorised or an exemption applies.
uncertainty: The applicable statutory exemptions are not specified in this piece.

claims.actor: A person issuing the relevant material
conditions: The SFC has authorised the issue or an exemption applies

evidence.quote: unless the SFC has authorised the issue or an exemption applies.

claims.statement: SFC authorisation of the issue and applicable exemptions are alternative exceptions to the described section 103 offence.
uncertainty: These exceptions are not stated to excuse compliance with the separate gift restriction.

claims.action: Highlight lack of guaranteed features in offering documents

evidence.quote: SFC-authorised funds without guaranteed features are required to highlight in their offering documents that they do not have these features

claims.statement: Funds without guaranteed features must highlight their absence in offering documents.
uncertainty: Footnote 1, which may identify or qualify the disclosure authority, is not supplied.

claims.action: Highlight risk of not recovering investment principal

evidence.quote: are required to highlight in their offering documents that they do not have these features and that investors may not get back the principal of their investment1.

claims.statement: Funds without guaranteed features must highlight in offering documents that investors may not recover their investment principal.

claims.action: Identify possible misleading attribution of distributor guarantees

evidence.quote: any guaranteed returns provided by distributors may create a misleading impression that these returns are provided by the underlying fund(s).

claims.statement: Distributor-provided guaranteed returns may misleadingly appear to be provided by the underlying funds.
uncertainty: This is a stated risk, not a finding that every arrangement is misleading.

claims.action: Consider paragraph 3.11 despite lack of structured-product classification
conditions: Offering guaranteed returns or other incentives in promoting SFC-authorised funds
Including where guaranteed returns would not constitute a structured product

evidence.quote: Even where the guaranteed returns offered would not constitute a “structured product” under the SFO, distributors are reminded to have regard to paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct in offering such returns or other incentives in promoting SFC-authorised funds

claims.statement: Distributors should have regard to paragraph 3.11 for guaranteed returns or other promotional incentives even if the returns are not a structured product.

claims.actor: Distributors offering returns or other incentives
conditions: Returns or other incentives are offered in promoting SFC-authorised funds

evidence.quote: in offering such returns or other incentives in promoting SFC-authorised funds, as they may be considered a gift that should not be offered to investors.

exceptions: The paragraph 3.11 fee or charge discount exception must be considered.
claims.statement: Guaranteed returns or other incentives may be considered gifts that should not be offered; the source does not categorically classify all such incentives as gifts.
uncertainty: Gift classification of any particular offer or component requires assessment under paragraph 3.11.

claims.action: Offer gifts when promoting a specific investment product
conditions: Promoting a specific investment product to a client

evidence.quote: distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.

exceptions: A discount of fees or charges
claims.statement: Distributors should not offer gifts in promoting a specific investment product to a client, except a discount of fees or charges.

claims.action: Offer gifts when promoting a particular investment-product type
conditions: Promoting a particular type of investment product to a client

evidence.quote: distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.

exceptions: A discount of fees or charges
claims.statement: The gift restriction also covers promotion of a particular type of investment product to a client, subject to the fee or charge discount exception.

claims.action: Except fee or charge discounts from the gift restriction
conditions: The offered benefit is a discount of fees or charges

evidence.quote: any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges)

claims.statement: Discounts of fees or charges are excepted from the stated gift restriction.
uncertainty: The text does not extend this exception to other components of a combined offer or specify how combined offers are assessed.

claims.action: Apply the gift restriction to gifts linked to product types
conditions: Gifts are offered in a way linked to a particular investment-product type

evidence.quote: If gifts are offered in such a way that they are linked to a particular type of investment product, such as certain types of funds or funds offered by certain fund houses, then such gifts will be bound by this requirement

exceptions: The stated fee or charge discount exception
claims.statement: Gifts linked to a product type are within the restriction, including links to certain fund types or funds offered by certain fund houses.
uncertainty: Footnote 3 is not supplied and may further explain this scope.

evidence.quote: The purpose of the requirement is to avoid the use of gifts to distract investors from the features and risks of a particular product.

claims.statement: The gift restriction aims to prevent gifts distracting investors from product features and risks.
uncertainty: The source does not make proof of actual distraction a condition of the restriction.

claims.action: Offer additional returns or incentives in breach of the named provisions
conditions: Additional returns are not part of product features in the relevant offering documents, or the benefit is another incentive
The offer breaches section 103 of the SFO or paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct

evidence.quote: In light of the concerns set out from paragraphs 5 to 10 above, when offering or promoting funds, distributors should not offer additional returns (which are not part of the product features set out in the relevant offering documents) or other incentives to investors in breach of section 103 of the SFO or paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct.

claims.statement: When offering or promoting funds, distributors should not offer additional returns outside documented product features or other incentives in breach of either named provision.
uncertainty: This is conditioned on breach of the named provisions; it is not an unconditional prohibition of every additional return or incentive.
Relevant offering documents are needed to distinguish product returns from additional distributor benefits.
